exercises.question: What does «Estará en casa» probably mean here?
options: He/She is probably at home. [Probablemente está en casa.]
He/She was at home. [Estuvo en casa.]
He/She must leave home. [Tiene que salir de casa.]

exercises.sentence: __ en casa, pero no estoy seguro.
exercises.english: He/She is probably at home, but I am not sure.
Something similar will probably happen next year.

sentences: Primero, no veo a Ana en la oficina. [First, I do not see Ana at the office.]
Después, pienso: estará en casa. [Then I think: she is probably at home.]
Finalmente, la llamaré para confirmarlo. [Finally, I will call her to confirm it.]

exercises.question: Which word means «uncertainty»?
options: incertidumbre [uncertainty]
probablemente [probably]
información [information]

exercises.sentence: La __ dice que quizá habrá cambios.
exercises.english: The forecast says that there may be changes.
The train will arrive late if there are problems on the line.

exercises.sentence: Serán las ocho, porque ya hay mucha gente en la calle.
options: It is probably eight o'clock, because there are already many people in the street.
It was eight o'clock, because there were already many people in the street.
It will be eight o'clock when many people are in the street.

exercises.sentence: Probablemente sucederá algo parecido el año que viene.
options: Something similar will probably happen next year.
Something similar probably happened last year.
Nothing similar will probably happen next year.

exercises.sentence: Serían las ocho cuando llegó el tren.
exercises.english: It was probably about eight when the train arrived.

options: Estará en casa, pero no estoy seguro. [She is probably at home, but I am not sure.]
Esté en casa, pero no estoy seguro. [She be at home, but I am not sure.]
Estuvo en casa, pero no estoy seguro. [She was at home, but I am not sure.]
Probablemente sucederá algo parecido. [Something similar will probably happen.]
Probablemente sucedió algo parecido. [Something similar probably happened.]
Probablemente sucedería algo parecido. [Something similar would probably happen.]
No, todavía hay mucha incertidumbre. [No, there is still a lot of uncertainty.]
No, todavía haya mucha incertidumbre. [No, there still be (subjunctive) a lot of uncertainty.]
No, todavía había mucha incertidumbre. [No, there was still a lot of uncertainty.]

template.prompt: Make a prediction using the future.
template.answer: Probablemente sucederá algo parecido el año que viene.

template.prompt: Use the future to make a guess about the present.
template.answer: Estará en casa, pero no estoy seguro.
